body:
## Assessment scope and result basis

This is an independent Proposal Review of the exact proposal subject. It establishes direction sufficiency for detailed Design only. It does not approve either model draft, implementation, activation, final closeout, publication, or automatic continuation. Vision alignment: aligned.

Challenge: pass. Canonical Code Review and plan instructions still require final holistic assessment and its delivery dependencies. The unidentified delivery-plan omission remains explicitly reported motivation, not independently verified evidence. Goals: pass. Shared policy ownership, explicit consequences, independent final review, and reduced duplication address that challenge. Scope: pass. All review families and their planning, routing, verification, governance and packaging consumers remain included, with representation changes conditional on a concrete gap. Governing principle: pass. One definition and specialist application preserve responsibility without selecting mechanics. Direction: pass. A bounded policy model within Workflow preserves specialized reviews and the existing gate sequence. Feasibility: pass. Existing canonical obligations support extraction; exact relocation, portability and compatibility require Design. Material impact: pass. Added model maintenance, context cost and mandatory fresh final review cost are disclosed without a measured token-saving claim. Vision-fit dimension: pass. Durable, inspectable judgments support trustworthy and resumable work. Downstream authority: pass. Detailed layout, fields, commands, implementation and activation remain unapproved. Requested decision: pass. The mandatory final review and coordinated consumer alignment are explicit direction decisions.

## Scope preservation and conditional gates

Scope-preservation result: pass. The initial intent and scope budget preserve every material goal in the user request, explicitly classify adoption dependencies, and explain exclusions. No hidden deferral or silent narrowing is identified. Scope-budget context applies and passes. No vision exception or missing standing-artifact gate applies. Recommended proposal edits: none.

## Current applicability reassessment

The proposal is byte-identical to the separately reviewed advisory r2 subject. This assessment does not infer applicability solely from that match. I inspected current Workflow ownership, preserved actor boundaries, stable-ID extraction mapping and prospective-adoption statements, plus the new Review and Closeout requirements as changed context. Those draft changes pursue the accepted direction and reveal no direction-level contradiction requiring proposal revision. They are not evidence that Design is adequate or approved. The unchanged canonical Code Review, plan and Verify obligations still support the proposal's feasibility independently of those drafts. Historical contract preservation and separate activation authority remain explicit. Current Constitution and Vision remain consistent with the direction. No material proposal concern was identified from this reassessment.

## Recording and authority

The user explicitly selected rigorloop-records-v2 for this initiative after the original isolated review. Status and explicitly selected full context identify that contract, the exact proposal reference, current model references and no existing reviews or blockers. This new current record preserves the earlier advisory records in place without migrating them or changing their original scope. The receiving actor must assess required current evidence before reliance; a successful CLI save supplies no judgment or progression authority. No routing mutation or Design Review is performed here. The proposal approval remains a direction judgment only.

## Inspected basis

CLI subject inspection supplied the identities and content for the proposal, current Workflow model, Review and Closeout draft requirements, CONSTITUTION.md, VISION.md, and canonical Code Review, plan and Verify skills. These are declared reads for this save. Model drafts were inspected only for proposal-impact assessment. No-map rationale: the named canonical policy subjects directly establish the bounded direction basis; no repository topology conclusion relies on the project map.
independence_basis: A separate delegated agent, independent_proposal_review, performed the original direction assessment and this current applicability reassessment. The user supplied the initial proposal and codex-root authored the repository artifact. This reviewer neither authored nor edited that proposal or the model drafts. Separate agent execution and direct subject inspection establish separation; the reviewer label alone does not.
